modeReason: Several stories clear the relevance threshold of 8 outright (a novel ChatGPT share-link hijack bug scores 12, a computer-science enrollment decline scores 12), and even the industry-dimension funding/loan story reaches the stricter threshold of 8 required since industry led the last three days.
phrase: A top AI lab raised less than half its funding goal. A bug in its chatbot let a shared link run a stranger's code in your account.
phraseAlternatives: A top AI lab asked for billions and got less than half. Meanwhile, one shared link could run a stranger's code inside your logged-in chatbot.
A leading AI lab's funding round fell short by billions. Its chatbot also had a bug that let one shared link hijack someone else's logged-in session.
A top AI lab missed its funding target by billions. Meanwhile, fewer students are studying computer science now that AI writes the code.

brief.concept: A company building stretches up for a floating pile of coins but catches only half, while beside it a chatbot speech bubble's cord labeled SHARE frays open just enough for a small hooded figure to slip inside toward a glowing key icon.
brief.metaphor: Running short on money and running short on security happen at the same time, in the same industry.

cast.who: a company building reaching up with both hands, catching only half of a floating pile of coins
the other half of the coin pile drifting just out of reach above the building
a chatbot speech bubble with a cord labeled SHARE, fraying open at one seam
a small hooded figure slipping through the frayed seam toward a glowing key icon inside the bubble

brief.composition: Split the frame into two calm panels divided by a thin gutter. Left panel: a building reaches upward, two hands catching only half of a floating coin pile, the rest sliding out of frame above it. Right panel: a speech-bubble robot with a frayed cord labeled SHARE, through whose torn seam a small hooded figure squeezes toward a glowing key icon inside the bubble. Keep each panel to 2 shapes max so the two facts of the day read as parallel, understated vignettes rather than one chaotic scene.
brief.alt: On the left, a building reaches up but only catches half of a floating pile of coins; on the right, a speech-bubble robot's frayed SHARE cord lets a small hooded figure slip inside toward a glowing key.
